rows.label: tlk70000004_02_msg0001
rows.name:
This is right under the King of Iira's
nose! Who'd normally think to attack
here?!

rows.label: tlk70000004_02_msg0002
rows.name:
Ah... But maybe that's the problem...
This enemy isn't normal, so that's
why this has happened.

rows.label: tlk70000004_02_msg0003
rows.name:
If you close your eyes to the fires of
war and rebellion happening on the
opposite shore, this is what happens.

rows.label: tlk70000004_02_msg0004
rows.name:
I'll tell Morumo and have the Chamber
of Commerce call an emergency meeting.
We won't make the same mistake again.

rows.label: tlk70000004_02_msg0005
rows.name:
...Looks like Tiko will have a hard
time for a while.
